verdicts.evidence: lines 760-782: submit, Import, both downloads, Show all, Stop, resume, new import each have a listener doing what the label says; Try again wired at 531-532; Back link (175) routes via hashchange (784).

lines 503-546: rows come from the user's CSV and issues from api.validateImport; 647-661: progress and totals come from api.runImport and error.imported. No hardcoded sample values or placeholder text.
lines 557-567: review shows counts ready, left out and per-problem tally beside the Import N contacts button (572); 702-714: import result repeats total, imported, not imported and rows left out.

lines 411-416, 762-768, 786-794: CSV text saved to sessionStorage on input and unload and restored on load; 513-530: text kept after a failed check; Back keeps the textarea and checked state (421-426). Reload returns to step 1 with the text.

line 181, 543: only preselection is the row filter (problems), which changes nothing; 438, 665: focus goes to the step heading, not the Import button, so Enter does not start an import; only good rows are sent (629).
lines 500-546, 627-632: paste or choose file, Check rows, Import N contacts; the only added step is the review of problem rows that the brief requires before importing. No dialogs.

Sections are add (142-167), review (170-203), import (206-229). Extras are the problem/all filter, CSV downloads of problem and not-imported rows (771, 780-781) and resume; each serves the review, decide or outcome tasks in the brief. No stat cards or tips.

line 163: Check rows is the only primary on step 1 (Try again is plain, 531); 571-573: Back becomes primary only when Import is hidden; 718-725: resume is primary only when stopped, new-btn primary only when resume is hidden.

lines 724-727: when rows remain, 'Start a new import' (which discards them, 746-755) is unstyled secondary and moved to the end of the action bar; it is not a form default and focus sits on the heading (665).

line 512, 524: Check rows is aria-disabled only during its own request; 734-735: Stop is disabled with 'Stopping...' beside it; 571, 575, 718-722: unusable buttons are hidden; 453-455: unreachable steps render as plain text.
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
All visible strings (135-226, 350-378, 400-406, 475-494, 530, 557-580, 672-724) concern the import task. No mention of implementation, mock data or unfinished features.
line 145: column and required-field hint sits above the two inputs it governs; line 214/695: 'Contacts already imported stay in the CRM.' sits beside Stop import. No other notes or callouts.

No sentence narrates the screen. Prose is the one-line format hint (145), labels (148, 155), status lines and result messages. 'added below' (489) reports where the file text went, not how to use the page.

lines 579 and 590: table caption 'N rows with problems' restates the selected radio 'Rows with problems (N)' directly above it, itself after the summary (559); 710-712: heading 'Import stopped' followed by 'You stopped the import.'
Headings are 'Import contacts', 'Add contacts', 'Review rows', 'Import finished' (135, 290-292, 705). No greetings, exclamation marks or congratulations in any string.

Labels: Check rows (163), Import N contacts (572), Download the N rows with problems (576), Show all N rows (621), Stop import (213), Import the remaining N contacts (719), Start a new import / Import another file (724), Try again (531).

lines 400-407: server codes REQUIRED, EMAIL_FORMAT, PHONE_FORMAT, DUPLICATE_IN_CRM are mapped to sentences with a fallback; 282: field names shown as Name, Email, Phone, Company; status shows 'Left out' or 'Ready' (610).

lines 519-533: raw ECONNRESET is discarded; message says rows could not be checked, nothing imported, text unchanged, with Try again. 712-713: import failure states counts with a resume button. 350, 367, 475, 494 name the problem and fix.

No 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', capitals or exclamation marks. Wording is 'could not be checked' (530), 'could not be read' (494), 'is missing', 'is not valid' (402-406), prefixed 'Problem:' (81). Subject is the data, not the user.

The table never renders empty (378 rejects zero rows; 587 falls back to all rows). Zero importable rows: line 558 says all rows have problems so nothing to import, and 573 makes 'Back to Add contacts' the primary action. Empty input: 350.

Distinct causes have distinct text and action: nothing entered (350, focus to field), heading with no contacts (378), all rows have problems (558, Back primary), check did not reach server (530-533, Try again). Filter is hidden when it could match nothing (578).

lines 517-534: failed check shows a message above the button with Try again and restores the editable, unchanged textarea; 655-661, 712-721: failed import keeps pending rows, states counts and offers 'Import the remaining N contacts'.
line 514: spinner and 'Checking N rows...' set before the call; 210-214, 668-672: import shows a progress bar, 'X of N contacts imported' and a Stop import button wired to AbortController (642, 736).

lines 511-546: the review view stays hidden until validateImport resolves, with only the busy status visible meanwhile; no empty-state text exists to flash. The import count during the run is live progress from the server (647-650).

line 107: cells use overflow-wrap anywhere; 375: missing fields default to '' so no undefined; 309: numbers use toLocaleString; 296, 589, 617-622: 300-row cap with 'Show all'; 64, 129: action rows wrap. Missing optional values show as blank cells.
lines 786-789: leaving during a running import triggers the browser prompt, otherwise text is saved; 791-794: text is restored on return; 762-768: saved 300 ms after each edit.

line 145 states the columns and required ones before input, but the 5 MB file limit (295, 474-476) appears only as an error after choosing a file. Two readings disagreed on whether that unstated size limit fails the rule.
line 145: 'Name and email are required' in words for the columns; 148, 155: the two inputs are alternatives joined by 'Or paste CSV text', and submitting with neither says so (350). No asterisks.
lines 762-768: the input handler shows no errors; validation runs only on submit (760, 503-509) and on file choice (474); 502, 462-466: messages are cleared at the next check.

lines 151, 157: file and textarea errors sit directly under their fields with a 'Problem:' text prefix (81) and a thicker border (56); 160: the server error, which belongs to no field, sits above the button; 605: row problems are inside the affected cell.
lines 504-509: a client rejection leaves the textarea untouched; 513, 525-530: a server rejection only toggles readOnly and leaves the value. The textarea is cleared only by newImport (749).

lines 505-507: on a rejected submit the textarea gets aria-invalid and focus; line 156: aria-describedby references csv-error; 149: file input references file-error. Errors are role=alert (151, 157, 160).

line 163: the submit button has no disabled state at load; 350, 504-508: submitting empty shows 'Choose a CSV file or paste CSV text.' and focuses the field; 512, 524: aria-disabled only while the check is in flight.

line 501: check returns early while state.checking, with busy text and aria-disabled (512-514); 628: startImport returns if a job exists; 741: resume returns while running; 732: stop ignores repeat presses.

line 514: busy status set synchronously on Check; 630: Import switches view at once; 734-735: Stop shows 'Stopping...'; 774, 776: filter and Show all re-render at once; 479: file read shows 'Reading name...'; downloads start immediately (393-397).

lines 545-546: a successful check moves to the review with its summary; 704-714: import end states imported, not imported and left-out counts under a changed heading; 530, 712: failures are stated in role=alert boxes.
line 706: 'N contacts were imported' reports a server-side result not otherwise visible; 489: the file status adds the line count. No toasts or banners confirming on-screen changes.
No timers remove messages (setTimeout only at 397 and 767). Errors render in place (151, 157, 160, 219) and stay until the next check or action (462-466, 685-686).

lines 746-755: 'Start a new import' after a stopped or failed run immediately clears the text, the saved copy (754) and the not-imported rows with no undo; going back cannot restore it (421-426). Stop import, by contrast, is resumable (739-744).

Import cannot be recalled. The review step acts as the confirmation: lines 557-567 state how many rows go in and how many are left out, the button reads 'Import N contacts' (572) beside 'Back to Add contacts', and focus is on the heading (438).
No confirmation dialogs in the page. The only prompt is the browser's beforeunload during a running import (786-787).
No optimistic updates: counts shown come from server progress callbacks (647-650) and the final or error result (651-660).
No modal dialogs; the three steps are in-page sections toggled with hidden (435).
No modal dialogs.
lines 135-166: heading, step list, then the file and paste inputs and Check rows; 171-198: review opens on the summary and the Import button, then the row table; 209-226: progress or result first.
lines 135-145: h1 'Import contacts', a one-line step list, then the form. No hero, greeting or introductory panel.

lines 557-567: the only summary numbers are rows ready, rows with problems and a tally per problem type, which inform the decision to go ahead; 672: progress count during the run. No stat cards or charts.

lines 179-183, 579-580: the filter is a visible radio pair with counts, and 'All rows (N)' clears it in one action; 590: caption states the filter and count; 620-621: truncation says 'Showing the first 300 of N rows' with Show all.

All controls are native: form submit (144, 163), file input, textarea, buttons, radios (181-182) and anchors (175, 454). Focus styles at 37; aria-disabled keeps buttons focusable (512). No click-only custom widgets or focus traps.

line 81: errors carry a 'Problem:' text prefix; 605: problem cells contain the problem text as well as a tint; 610: status is the words 'Left out' or 'Ready'; 42, 453: current step is bold, underlined and has aria-current.

Live regions exist in the markup before use: role=status at 150, 164, 172, 218, 228 and role=alert at 151, 157, 160, 219; progress announced each quarter (673-677). Gap: the brief 'Stopping...' text (214, 735) has no role, but the result follows with focus (665).
No accordions, menus, comboboxes or tabs. 'Show all N rows' (776) is a one-way load, not a toggle; steps are links with aria-current.

lines 122-130: under 640px table rows become stacked label and value pairs via data-label (596-609), action buttons go full width; 40: steps wrap; 49-57: inputs are 100% wide at 16px; 29: 1rem gutters. No dialogs or fixed widths.
